name: One Click Order
author: Plugin Nest

sections.description:
One Click Order is a lightweight plugin that replaces the lengthy checkout process with a single, customizable order form. Whether you’re selling digital goods, services, or physical products, it helps you reduce abandoned carts and improve conversions.

Key Features:
* One-page order form with drag-and-drop receipt upload
* Supports WooCommerce payment gateways and manual payment methods
* Seamless integration with WooCommerce orders
* Admin dashboard to view, confirm, or delete orders
* Mobile-optimized and responsive
* Use shortcodes or enable the button directly from plugin settings

Upgrade to the Pro version for features like:
* Sticky Buy Now buttons
* Advanced filters and search in admin
* Visual analytics dashboard
* Export orders to CSV/PDF
* Enhanced color and layout customization
* Priority support and frequent updates

Credits

Developed by Plugin Nest – pluginnest1@gmail.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/one-click-order
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to One Click Order > Settings to customize
sections.faq:
Will my orders be saved in WooCommerce?

Yes! All orders are synced with WooCommerce automatically.

Can customers upload payment proof?

Yes, they can drag and drop their receipt while submitting the order form.

Do I need to code anything?

No coding needed. The plugin is fully customizable via the admin panel.
